text: Dense passage retrieval uses continuous representations to index documents for open-domain question answering.
FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, developed by Meta AI.
Cross-encoders perform full self-attention over the concatenated query and passage pair, achieving higher accuracy than bi-encoders.
BM25 is a term matching algorithm based on probabilistic retrieval principles and inverse document frequency.
Quantization maps continuous values or floating point numbers to discrete low-precision representations like INT8 to accelerate inference.
Docker packages applications into standardized units with all dependencies for reliable deployment across environments.
